source.author: verg
source.text: Ut primum placati animi et trepida ora quierunt, praefatus divos solio rex infit ab alto:
source.text_original: Ut primum placati animi et trepida ora quierunt, / praefatus divos solio rex infit ab alto: /
source.text_english: As soon as their minds were calmed and their anxious faces fell still, the king, after invoking the gods, begins from his high throne:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nuntius hunc solio Boreas proturbat ab alto:
reuse.text_original: nuntius hunc solio Boreas proturbat ab alto: /
reuse.text_english: Boreas drives this man from his high throne by a messenger.
